description: Emperor Time dogma hooks. Short. They bite.

hooks.prompt: Emperor Time dogma: purpose is autonomous DONE, not token theater. Read SKILL.md only if this is engineering work. Define DONE in .emperor/tasks/<id>/DONE.md and prove it with scripts/done.sh. No easy path. Swarm-emulate if the host has no swarm. Memory is CONJECTURE.

hooks.command: if [ -d .emperor/tasks ]; then last=$(ls -1d .emperor/tasks/* 2>/dev/null | tail -n1); if [ -n "$last" ] && [ -f "$last/DONE.md" ]; then bash scripts/done.sh "$last" || echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: DONE.md probes failed — you are not done.'; else echo '[Emperor Time] STOP: no DONE.md — define DONE before claiming it.'; fi; fi
